title: Plan AF: AI Audiobook & Podcast
summary: Text prep → voice selection → segmented recording → music & SFX → publish
scenario: For individuals and teams turning books, articles or topics into audiobooks, podcasts or spoken-word audio.

steps.title: Text prep
steps.detail: Convert the source into a spoken-style script: split into chapters, add paragraph markers, cut written-form language. Annotate emotion and pacing cues per paragraph for the TTS.
steps.tips: Keep each segment under ~30 seconds of speech so a bad take only needs one segment re-recorded.

steps.title: Voice selection
steps.detail: Preview 3-5 candidate voices and pick one that matches the content's tone. For Chinese, start with Fish Speech's stock voices; for long-form, prefer ElevenLabs.
steps.tips: Compare candidates reading the same opening line — don't choose from voice-list descriptions alone.

steps.title: Segmented recording
steps.detail: Generate speech paragraph by paragraph and listen to each, fixing stress, phrasing and proper-noun pronunciation. Lock names and places in a pronunciation dictionary so the whole book stays consistent.
steps.tips: Fix unusual words in the dictionary before generating, or every segment will pronounce them differently.

steps.title: Music & SFX
steps.detail: Use Suno for background music or intro/outro, keep it under about -20dB as a bed. Assemble segments in Descript with fades and pauses, and strip flubs and noise.
steps.tips: Duck the music side-chained to the voice so music steps aside when the narration speaks.

steps.title: Publish
steps.detail: Export a standard audio format, design a cover and title, upload to podcast platforms or distribution. Add chapter timestamps and a transcript so listeners can skip and search.
steps.tips: Ship one episode through the RSS and review flow first, then schedule the batch.

pitfalls.title: Recording the whole book in one pass
pitfalls.detail: Long-form TTS errors compound; segmenting lets you fix cheaply instead of expecting a one-shot master.

pitfalls.title: Voice that doesn't match the tone
pitfalls.detail: The content decides the voice — audition first instead of chasing a trendy-sounding voice.

pitfalls.title: Music drowning the voice
pitfalls.detail: Keep BGM low with voice priority; if you can't hear the narration, redo it.

pitfalls.title: Licensing and AI-voice disclosure
pitfalls.detail: Platforms have rules for AI-generated speech; check them before publishing.
